decisions.reason: As a recent launch that is close to the core modular sensing platform, it fits the firm's established architecture and is unlikely to be withdrawn so soon when management can still justify the investment as part of platform expansion.

This module builds directly on the firm's industrial electronics offer and its dedicated product page signals visible commitment, which under escalation of commitment makes withdrawal especially unlikely absent clear failure evidence.

A solid state relay module is a natural complement to the firm's automation and control ecosystem, so the firm is likely to retain it and interpret any early weakness as temporary while leveraging existing development and production investments.

Although the server room monitoring kit is somewhat less central than core modules and may be more niche, it still builds on the firm's existing components and documentation assets, so management would more likely keep it for now than admit an early reversal.
